assets.description: A logo featuring a large pink satin bow with gold edging above the pink text "My Sweet Home", surrounded by gold glitter rings and stars, with a gold number below.
assets.notes: Text visible: "My Sweet Home" and "71-014463". Gold rings are cropped at the edges, and the image looks like a low-resolution screenshot, so it should not be enlarged. The pink text on white has fairly low contrast. White background makes it easy to place on light pages.

assets.description: A set of three red body care products (body lotion, hand cream and fragrance mist) stands on a white perforated table beside pink peonies and a handmade cream ceramic cup and saucer decorated with red hearts, with white blossoms blurred in the background.
assets.notes: Bright, soft natural lighting with a pleasant blurred floral background. Portrait format, so it needs cropping for wide hero use. Empty space in the upper right could hold text. Text visible: "JAPANESE CHERRY BLOSSOM", "BATH & BODY WORKS", "DAILY NOURISHING BODY LOTION", "SHEA BUTTER HAND CREAM", "FINE FRAGRANCE MIST", "236 ml/8 fl oz", "1 FL OZ / 29 mL". Third-party brand labels are prominent, so check the rights to use them.

assets.description: Two water bottles with wildflower prints, one cream and one lavender, standing in a woven wicker basket with a linen lining on a white perforated table.
assets.notes: Bright, soft natural light with a pleasant blurred floral background. The portrait crop is tight on the sides and the busy perforated pattern leaves little clean space for text. Not wide enough for a hero. Text visible: "FLOWE" (cream bottle, cut off), "LACE F" (purple bottle, cut off). There is a small light edge artifact on the right side of the frame.

assets.description: A cream cushion cover with embroidered wildflowers, butterflies and a dandelion sits on a white perforated metal chair in front of white blossom branches.
assets.notes: Bright, soft lighting with a pleasant floral backdrop and the embroidery is clearly visible. A '1/2' slideshow counter overlay is in the top right corner, so it needs cropping or removal. It looks like a screenshot, so resolution may be limited. The portrait orientation makes it unsuitable for a wide hero. The white background is busy and low in contrast, leaving little clean space for text.

assets.description: Four floral-patterned insulated tumblers with handles, gold bands, colored lids and bow-shaped straw toppers stand on a white perforated metal table in front of white blossom branches.
assets.notes: Bright, soft, appealing styling with a blurred floral backdrop. A screenshot-style '1/3' counter badge is visible in the top-right corner and the image appears to be a social media capture, so it needs cropping before use. The tall portrait format limits wide hero use, and the busy table in the foreground is cluttered. Text visible: 'STANLEY', 'LoveShackFancy' (partly legible on the cups), '1/3'.

assets.description: A white ornate mirrored tray holds a tulip-patterned espresso cup and saucer, surrounded by gift boxes of cream ceramic cups and saucers decorated with bows, hearts and stars.
assets.notes: Warm, soft lighting with a cohesive pastel look. Scene is busy and cluttered at the edges, and the Instagram '2/3' counter badge in the top-right corner must be cropped out before use. Cropping tightly around the mirror tray would give a cleaner product shot. Little empty space for text, so not suited as a hero image.

gaps.reason: The Home page needs a strong, wide banner image that introduces the brand and its products. The current product photos are close-ups and none is clearly a hero shot.
The About page should tell the story of the business and build trust. No photos of the people behind the products exist.
The About page needs visuals of how the products are made, packaged or prepared. This supports the handmade, personal feel of the brand.
Customers ordering from the site need to see how products arrive, such as boxed or wrapped gifts. This supports the primary goal of ordering.

gaps.need: individual product photos on a plain background
gaps.reason: The Products page needs consistent, clear shots of each item for catalog cards. The current photos are styled group scenes, and several are only medium quality.
Buyers need to see the embroidery, prints and materials to feel confident ordering. This supports the primary goal of ordering.
The Contact page would be more trustworthy and easier to use with a photo of the shop or pickup location.
